method.community_labels: Communities of at least 4 authors, in community order. Institution: the most common first primary affiliation among members (a member without one counts its first institution other than 'System'), kept when at least 35% of members and at least 2 share it. Topic: among tags on at least 40% of members' topics, the one with the highest lift (share in the community divided by share across all authors), ties by share then tag, kept when lift is at least 1.15. A null field means no label passed.
method.layout: ForceAtlas2 (networkx), started from the spring layout (seed 42) and run for 1000 iterations with scaling ratio 10, strong gravity 0.05 and node mass 1 + weighted degree (graphology inferSettings); coordinates centred and scaled to [-1, 1].
method.works: all region works in the Atlas export (unscreened query hits, no plastic screen)
